mapper.select: SELECT id FROM hr_employee WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{employeeId} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_salary_slip WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND employee_id = #{employeeId} AND deleted = 0 AND status NOT IN ('CANCELLED','VOIDED') AND (JSON_CONTAINS(JSON_EXTRACT(components, '$[*].payrollPeriodId'), CAST(#{periodId} AS JSON)) OR JSON_CONTAINS(JSON_EXTRACT(components, '$[*].payrollPeriodId'), JSON_QUOTE(CAST(#{periodId} AS CHAR))))

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_employee_referral WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND referrer_employee_id = #{employeeId} AND bonus_status = 'PENDING' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(bonus_condition_snapshot, '$.payrollPeriodId')) = CAST(#{periodId} AS CHAR)
SELECT * FROM hr_employee_referral WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND candidate_id = #{candidateId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT candidate_id FROM hr_employee_referral referral WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND candidate_id > #{afterId} AND status = 'OFFERED' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hr_audit_log audit WHERE audit.tenant_id = referral.tenant_id AND audit.business_domain = 'HR_REFERRAL' AND audit.business_id = referral.referral_id AND audit.operation_type = 'EMPLOYMENT_SOURCE') ORDER BY candidate_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE hr_recruitment_requisition SET hired_count = COALESCE(hired_count, 0) + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{requisitionId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM hr_employee_referral WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND referral_id = #{referralId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM hr_position WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{positionId} AND status = 1
SELECT id AS value, position_name AS label FROM hr_position WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 1 AND position_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') ORDER BY position_name, id

choose.when: SELECT id AS value, component_name AS label FROM hr_comp_component WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 1 AND component_type = 'VARIABLE' AND taxable = 1 AND component_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') ORDER BY sort_order, id
choose.otherwise: SELECT period_id AS value, period_name AS label FROM hr_payroll_period WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'OPEN' AND end_date >= CURRENT_DATE AND period_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') ORDER BY start_date, period_id

mapper.select: SELECT file_id, file_name, file_size, file_hash, biz_id AS business_id FROM sys_file WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND file_id = #{fileId} AND file_type = 'HR_REFERRAL_RESUME' AND deleted = 0 AND access_type = 'PRIVATE' AND url = '' AND portal_owner_id IS NULL AND (biz_type IS NULL OR biz_type = 'HR_REFERRAL_RESUME') FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_file SET biz_id = #{referralId}, biz_type = 'HR_REFERRAL_RESUME', file_hash = #{hash} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND file_id = #{fileId} AND file_type = 'HR_REFERRAL_RESUME' AND deleted = 0 AND biz_id IS NULL AND biz_type IS NULL AND access_type = 'PRIVATE' AND url = '' AND portal_owner_id IS NULL
